Communication.description: A policy can inspect intent/resources without parsing the optional natural-language text.

DiscardView.description: Private choices for the receiving seat. Other seats and spectators never receive them.

research_hands.description: Only research spectators receive hands; seated agents still have normal redaction.

oneOf.description: Only the thief and victim receive the resource identity.

Resources.description: Resource counts in brick, lumber, wool, grain, ore order.

Topology.description: Stable geometry shared by every state. Coordinates use an integer pointy-hex lattice.
